purpose: Explain observational pre-drive cabin readiness with explicit climate/drive coverage, exclusions, common support and uncertainty.
primaryGoal: Compare qualified observed HVAC-active departures with explicitly HVAC-off controls without claiming causation, energy savings or complete source coverage.

routeEvidence.detail: Lazy import of the exact assigned page.
SafeRoute mounting at preconditioning-effectiveness; browser reachability unverified.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a vehicle; cancellation signal forwarded; safeArray projection. Backend defaults to the preceding seven days and builds a signal.StateReader forward-folded timeline. Backend accepts explicit date bounds, but this hook does not pass them. No latest/snapshot API is used for historical comparisons.

Selected vehicle is required; limit clamped to 1-1000; cancellation forwarded; MODERATE staleTime and safeArray preserved. No pagination or date bounds at this call site. Drive repository ordering and full date-filter behavior were not inspected.

Memoized local join of returned histories. Celsius and seconds retained; invalid/duplicate rows accounted explicitly. Distinct cabin transitions qualify thermal support. Unknown HVAC prevents control classification. Overall medians use only hot/cold strata containing both groups; directory newest-first with default cap 80.

Workspace vehicle reused without a duplicate picker. Temperature differences converted by subtracting converted zero, preserving Fahrenheit delta semantics. Display precision/locale and duration preferences remain outside raw query data.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Source-status precedence is implemented locally here and again in DataAvailability:38-64; coverage omits paused state while availability includes it.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consolidate the domain status derivation within the existing preconditioning feature rather than introducing a new universal status registry. Preserve localized labels and source-specific diagnostics.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Border/surface/padding mini-card presentation repeats in departure cards, strata, thresholds and methodology. Existing surface primitives should be evaluated; source repetition alone does not justify a new shared component.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse a suitable existing Card/LayoutCard presentation variant where it preserves article/list semantics, density and every diagnostic; retain local domain components if no exact match is proven.

observed: Coverage/availability sources stack before lg; methodology progresses to two and three columns.
Directory remains a semantic list with two diagnostic columns expanding to four/six.
Charts use ResponsiveContainer and fixed 300px plotting height.

issues.detail: Threshold matrix starts at two columns even at 320px and expands to seven at xl; long localized labels and duration values have no page-specific narrow-container fallback. Overflow is a risk, not a demonstrated runtime failure.
issues.fix: Verify allocated widths and 200% text; use existing Grid one-column narrow-container behavior if needed, keeping all seven gates and affected counts.

issues.detail: Directory has a nested max-height scrolling list without explicit region label or focus affordance. Keyboard/touch reachability of the final card needs verification; native browser scroll focus behavior cannot be certified by source.
issues.fix: Exercise keyboard and touch at narrow widths; reuse an existing scroll-region pattern with a localized accessible name and keyboard reachability only where required, without removing card diagnostics.

observed: Meaningful localized refresh name; decorative icons aria-hidden.
Ledger has explicit accessible section name.
Query notices use status/alert and polite announcements where appropriate.
Four charts provide ariaLabel and dataColumns through the existing export/table-capable chart pipeline.
Badges provide textual dispositions; color is not the only domain signal.
accessibility.acceptance: Keyboard, focus, screen-reader/chart-table open states, effective contrast, forced colors, target sizes and reduced motion are UNVERIFIED.

states.initialLoading: QueryStatus announces loading; SectionBody uses source-specific skeletons; source summaries can resolve independently.
states.empty: Both returned empty arrays produce a valid-empty explanation; no classified/comparable results receive distinct passive explanations while shells remain mounted.
states.error: Initial fatal errors have independent climate/drive retry actions in the ledger. Climate-only disposition does not depend on drive success.
states.partial: Separate coverage cards preserve successfully resolved source information; joined analysis correctly requires both sources.
states.refreshFailure: deriveDataState fatalError/refreshError split retains cached measurements; query status warns and offers refresh retry.
states.unknown: No vehicle, unresolved availability, missing temperatures and unavailable comparisons remain distinct from measured zero.
states.stale: PageContainer receives both queries for worst-query freshness; feature query state carries neither source last-success timestamps nor isStale.
states.offline: Initial paused requests explicitly show an offline notice; retained paused requests are not represented correctly by the local state adapter.

issues.detail: climate.isPaused is set only when !climateHasData; drives repeats this at line 119. A paused refetch with retained data therefore becomes isPaused=false. Downstream ledger and coverage retained checks relying on resolved && isPaused cannot activate for this state.
issues.fix: Carry actual paused transport state independently of hasData; retain measurements and distinguish initial offline from offline-retained in notices/briefs. Verify against inherited query policy, not by changing retries or cache values.

issues.detail: Coverage status has loading/error/refresh-error/fetching/resolved/pending branches but no paused branch. Initial offline can be labeled Pending in this section even while the evidence ledger says Paused offline.
issues.fix: Use the deduplicated domain source-status mapping with distinct paused and retained-paused labels.

visualIssues.detail: Six adjacent KPI contexts use indigo, cyan, purple, emerald, amber and conditional severity icons. These are toned-down colors, not neon, but unrelated hues still compete with evidence severity.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral semantic icon tokens for non-status metrics; reserve subdued severity hues for actual confidence/availability meanings. Preserve explicit chart series identity and user chart palettes.

architectureIssues.detail: Historical analysis consumes only workspace vehicle. It does not use useRangeState, and /preconditioning-effectiveness is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS. Histories use an explicitly disclosed seven-day climate default and independent 1000-drive cap rather than the shared analysis window.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should assess adopting the header-owned date window and extend typed history hooks/query keys to pass both bounds. Verify complete server filtering and bounded-source disclosures; retain overlap gates, drive cap semantics and all explanations. Do not add a second picker or simply filter loaded rows.

architectureIssues.detail: Hourly aggregation deliberately uses browser-local getHours and its subtitle explicitly discloses browser-local time. This is not proof of a defect, but it differs from potentially saved workspace timezone semantics and must not be silently changed during date-scope modernization.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep current browser-local buckets unless the integration owner defines a tested timezone contract covering workspace preference, DST and export labels; report unknown equivalence rather than rebucketing cosmetically.

priority.first: Fix offline-retained source presentation and consolidate conflicting source labels.
priority.next: Coordinate historical workspace range integration; validate mobile diagnostics and chart/table accessibility.
priority.last: Reduce incidental KPI icon color variation without disturbing semantic/status or user palette choices.
